figurative_meaning_en: Marriage is imminent; wedding preparations are underway
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাড়িতে ফুল ফোটা হয়েছে, সবাই খুশি।
গ্রামে ফুল ফোটার খবর ছড়িয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: Wedding preparations are underway in their house, everyone is happy.
The news of the impending marriage spread in the village.
note: This idiom metaphorically compares the onset of marriage to a flower blooming, reflecting Bengali cultural views on marriage as a joyful blossoming event.
